newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chirac arrives for brief talks with Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: Chirac arrives for brief talks with Yeltsin.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac arrived in Moscow on Sunday for a brief meeting with President Boris Yeltsin.

Chirac, who is on his way home to Paris after a four-day state visit to China, is expected to spend just over an hour with his Russian counterpart. Officials expect them to discuss a NATO-Russia security treaty to be signed in Paris on May 27, as well as bilateral trade and economic issues.

Chirac, accompanied by his wife Bernadette and a delegation of about a dozen French officials, was met at the Vnukovo-2 government airport by Russian Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Bulgak. Chirac left in a motorcade.

Russian security officials said the French leader would meet Yeltsin at a residence not far from the airport. They declined to say which. Chirac was due to fly on to Paris at 9.30 p.m. (1730 GMT) and may speak to reporters before leaving.
The French president has been one of the Western leaders most sympathetic to Russian fears raised by the planned expansion of NATO into eastern Europe.

Russian and NATO negotiators announced a deal last week on a treaty laying down a new relationship between Moscow and its old Cold War adversary. It gives Moscow a say in NATO decisions affecting Russia and contains assurances that the West will not deploy nuclear and other arms further east.
